public_rationale: On October 28, 2026, the Federal Reserve described economic activity as expanding at a strong pace [e1]. That assessment establishes neither a qualifying downturn nor a central ChatGPT-related contribution to one, leaving the conditional forecast unresolved [e1].
limitations: The Federal Reserve's contemporaneous assessment does not definitively exclude an earlier or developing contraction.

from_speaker: will be at the center of the mess
our_interpretation: The White House and recession context points to a US economic downturn.
Goes down means a broad recession or comparable economy-wide contraction, not simply a fall in AI stock prices.
At the center means a major causal contribution from the ChatGPT-centered generative-AI boom or its reversal, rather than mere involvement.
criteria.support_condition: After a qualifying downturn occurs, credible economic evidence identifies the ChatGPT-related generative-AI boom or bust as a central contributor.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying downturn occurs, credible economic evidence establishes that ChatGPT-related activity was peripheral and other causes explain the downturn.
